text.p: Schmalbach-Lubeca AG said on Monday that it and Pechiney SA planned to merge their metal packaging activities in a joint venture consisting of London-based Doughty Hanson & Co, Pechiney and Schmalbach-Lubeca.

Schmalbach-Lubeca, a subsidiary of German industrial group Viag AG, said the firms had signed a letter of intent but that further talks would have to be held and agreement was needed from competition authorities, shareholders and employees before the deal could be completed.
Schmalbach-Lubeca and Pechiney would have shareholdings of 20 percent each in the joint venture for the time being, the German company said in a statement.
Schmalbach said the aim of the joint venture was to strengthen the firms' European market position and use synergy benefits.
Schmalbach said its metal packaging activities would generate sales of 1.1 billion marks in 1996 and that the joint venture would probably have sales of 2.0 billion marks in 1997.
